description: IJSN - CICLOVIA PRAÇA DO PAPA - SANTUÁRIO ANCHIETA is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Mapeamento de infraestruturas cicloviárias existente e planejadas entre a Praça do Papa (Vitória) e o Santuário Nacional de São José de Anchieta. Elaborado a partir de informações das prefeituras municipais, dos planos de mobilidade e imagens de satélite. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Anchieta, Ciclovia, Vitoria, Brazil, Espirito Santo. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
